speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an adolescent with delayed menarche, unusual physical features, and a history of bone fragility. To understand the root cause, are you experiencing excessive bruising, joint pain, or have you had any fractures from minor injuries?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), specifically 21-hydroxylase deficiency.
